thesis: Realised cash growth and margin compression are independent facts with no matched bridge proving which dominates future shareholder returns. Both cases depend on unverified acquisition funding and normalisation, so neither establishes entry value. Backlog and organic demand support opportunity, while the extended chart limits immediate timing conviction.
strongest_counterexample: Organic sales grew 14%, electrical backlog 43%, and FCF 22% to $874m, giving demand and actual cash support beyond a backlog-only narrative.
invalidation_conditions: A subsequent comparable quarter restores segment margin to at least 23.9% (derived prior-year 23.1% plus disclosed 80bp) while FCF stays above zero and acquisition obligations are reconciled, removing the principal conversion/funding conflict.
A subsequent comparable FCF result at or below zero alongside segment margin below 23.1% would invalidate the retained funded-growth counterweight.
evidence_gaps: Matched organic cash conversion and backlog returns.
decisive_factors: Reported FCF growth is not a matched organic cash-margin comparison; RSI80.5096.
